translation:
Purple bark (紫荊皮), arisaema (南星, each one liang), hibiscus (芙蓉, two liang), duhuo (獨活), angelica dahurica (白芷), red peony (赤芍藥, each five qian). Grind the above together into powder, mix with ginger juice and tea water, apply warm; for injuries with blue-purple color that does not recede for a long time, add five qian of cinnamon (肉桂). <ins>Gu Chi San (固齒散)</ins> Drynaria (骨碎補), mouse bone (牡鼠骨, calcined to ash). Grind together into a fine powder, store in a porcelain jar for use. <ins>Feng Kou Yao (封口藥)</ins> (see the nasal pillar bone injury)
[Figure: Front view 21]
